message.abstract:
<jats:p>
            We resolve some open conjectures from the OEIS about Hardinian arrays (see A253217). In particular, we show via the transfer matrix method that
            <jats:italic>
              H
              <jats:sub>r</jats:sub>
            </jats:italic>
            (
            <jats:italic>n, k</jats:italic>
            ), the number of
            <jats:italic>n × k</jats:italic>
            Hardinian arrays with parameter
            <jats:italic>r</jats:italic>
            is a polynomial in
            <jats:italic>n</jats:italic>
            of degree
            <jats:italic>r</jats:italic>
            when
            <jats:italic>r</jats:italic>
            and
            <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
            are fixed and
            <jats:italic>n</jats:italic>
            is sufficiently large. Our implementation of the main result in Maple and Python involves computing with large, sparse matrices, both numeric and symbolic.
          </jats:p>
title: Rectangular Hardinian Arrays
